description: Five golden demo scenarios (Plan.md §13 / MEMBER_6.md §6) as machine-readable fixtures for the Phase 1 stub harness. Each scenario is executed through integration.assembler.Assembler with stub specialists; the out_of_corpus variant must produce a safe abstention (HTTP 200). In Phase 2 the same fixtures run against the real wired specialists.

scenarios.title: Traditional knowledge + patentability (classical formulation)
scenarios.query: Can I patent a classical Ayurvedic formulation from an authoritative text?

expect.tkdl_pointer: answer text names TKDL/tkdl.res.in (M3 behavior) — or the M4 tkdl_pointer field once M4 is wired in Phase 2
expect.jurisdiction_separation: answer must not name Madrid or Hague

out_of_corpus.query: What is the fee for renewing a trademark in Japan under the Madrid Protocol?
out_of_corpus.expected: abstention (HTTP 200, abstention=true, no citations, no fabricated content). Same out-of-corpus topic M3's own test suite uses: international trademark renewal is not in the India corpus.
out_of_corpus.note: Out-of-corpus variants deliberately change TOPIC (like the real workstreams' own abstention tests) rather than paraphrase the golden query — a near-neighbour question about the same documented procedure would legitimately be answered.

scenarios.title: ABS / biological-resource question (not patents)
scenarios.query: I want to commercialise a formulation using a plant collected in India - what approvals do I need?

expect.not_patents: domain is ABS_TK (see finding F-03 on M1's routing signals) and the answer is not a Section 3(p) patentability answer

out_of_corpus.query: What is the fee for NBA approval to commercialise a plant-based formulation?
out_of_corpus.expected: abstention (HTTP 200, abstention=true, no citations, no fabricated content). Mirrors M4's documented rule: the curated ABS corpus contains no fee/amount figures, so a fee question must abstain rather than invent a number.

scenarios.title: Formulation classification: food (Ayurveda-Aahar) vs classical medicine
scenarios.query: Is my herbal product a food or medicine? It claims to support daily immunity and wellness.

expect.query_flow: free-text query flow abstains toward the guided classify flow (M2 is answers-driven)

classify_medicine.regime_distinction: drug regime named (D&C Act / Section 3(p) exposure / TKDL pointer)

expect.discrimination: the two answer-sets MUST land in different categories with different relevant_regimes

out_of_corpus.expected: Uncertain with needs_clarification=true and a clarification_prompt (never a guessed category)

scenarios.title: Indian IP: GI registration for a region-tied Ayurvedic product
scenarios.query: How do I register a GI tag for an Ayurvedic product tied to a region?

out_of_corpus.query: Can I copyright my yoga video series in India?
out_of_corpus.expected: abstention (HTTP 200, abstention=true, no citations, no fabricated content). Same weak-evidence topic M3's own test suite uses.

scenarios.title: International patent filing: PCT, not Madrid, not Hague
scenarios.query: I want to file a patent for a new Ayurvedic drug outside India - what route do I use?

out_of_corpus.query: How is spacecraft lease depreciation taxed?
out_of_corpus.expected: abstention (HTTP 200, abstention=true, no citations, no fabricated content). Same out-of-corpus topic M5's own test suite uses.
